criteria.description: Low back pain has persisted for at least 6 weeks

criteria.description: At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (e.g., physical therapy, NSAIDs, chiropractic, home exercise) documented with duration or dates, without adequate improvement
criteria.policy_citation: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine - https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/200_299/0236.html

criteria.description: Recent physical examination with neurological findings (strength, reflexes and/or sensation) documented
criteria.policy_citation: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine - https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/200_299/0236.html

criteria.description: Prior lumbar imaging status documented (no lumbar MRI in the prior 12 months, or a clinical change since the last study)
criteria.policy_citation: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine - https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/200_299/0236.html

criteria.description: Red flag: signs of cauda equina syndrome (saddle anesthesia, new urinary retention or incontinence, decreased rectal tone)
criteria.policy_citation: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine - https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/200_299/0236.html

criteria.description: Red flag: severe or progressive neurological deficit

criteria.description: Red flag: suspected malignancy (history of cancer with new back pain, or unexplained weight loss)

criteria.description: Red flag: suspected spinal infection (fever, IV drug use, immunosuppression)
criteria.policy_citation: Aetna Clinical Policy Bulletin 0236: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT) of the Spine - https://www.aetna.com/cpb/medical/data/200_299/0236.html

criteria.description: Red flag: significant trauma or suspected vertebral fracture
